question: How much does delivery cost?
answer: Delivery is free on orders above ₹499. Below that, a flat ₹49 delivery fee applies.

question: How long does delivery take?
answer: Orders reach metro cities in 2 to 4 days and other cities in 4 to 7 days.

question: Do you deliver to my pincode?
answer: We deliver across India. Enter your pincode on the product page to check delivery to your area.

question: Which payment methods can I use?
answer: UPI, debit and credit cards, net banking and cash on delivery.

question: Is cash on delivery available?
answer: Yes, for orders up to ₹3,000. A ₹30 cash on delivery fee applies.

question: How do I track my order?
answer: Go to My Orders and tap Track. You also get an SMS with the tracking link once the order ships.

question: Can I cancel my order?
answer: Yes, from My Orders until the order ships. After it ships, you can return it once it is delivered.

question: Can I change my delivery address after ordering?
answer: Only before the order ships. Contact support with your order ID to change it.

question: What is your return policy?
answer: Most items can be returned within 7 days of delivery if they are unused and in the original packing.

question: How do I return an item?
answer: Go to My Orders, choose the item and tap Return. A pickup is arranged within 2 days.

question: When will I get my refund?
answer: Refunds are sent within 5 to 7 working days after the returned item reaches us, to the same UPI, card or bank account.

question: I received a damaged or wrong item. What do I do?
answer: Report it within 48 hours from My Orders with a photo. We will send a replacement or a full refund.

question: How do I use a coupon code?
answer: Enter the code on the payment page and tap Apply. Only one coupon can be used per order.

question: How do I reset my password?
answer: Tap Forgot Password on the login page and follow the link sent to your email.

question: What are your support hours?
answer: Our support team is available 9 AM to 9 PM, all days.

question: Are your teas fresh?
answer: All teas are packed within 3 months of harvest. The pack date is printed on every pack.

question: How should I store tea?
answer: Keep it in an airtight container, away from sunlight and moisture.

question: Can I return an opened pack of tea?
answer: No. For hygiene reasons, opened food items cannot be returned unless they arrived damaged.

question: Do you sell gift hampers?
answer: Yes. Gift hampers start at ₹799 and include a free greeting card.

question: Are your snacks vegetarian?
answer: Yes, all snacks are vegetarian. Allergen details are printed on each pack.
